scope: Six authored Telugu profile samples, one take per phrase/profile, no user media
conditioning: No reference, forced duration, accent or pitch instruction.
pitch_diagnostic_limit: Vocal pitch diagnostic only; the source classifier is not validated as a generated-voice gender or naturalness judge.

possible_omission.finding: Expected files noun absent in ASR; other major name/time/channel/count/action elements retained. Requires listening; not a confirmed audible omission.
possible_omission.listener_followup: User confirms all words audible; ASR omission was not confirmed by listening.

manual_text_asr_audit.other_samples: Greeting/question/well clause and expressive major content recognizable despite ASR spelling substitutions.
manual_text_asr_audit.independent_review: Second agent independently read all six authored ASR forms; no additional model calls.

limitations: Gender instructions are trained upstream on English/Chinese; Telugu generalization is screened only.
User accepted perceived voice match and word audibility for these six samples; stable identity and long-video quality remain unproven.
No reference conditioning, forced duration, pitch shift or speech-rate control; fixed seed 20261010 each call.
Three different sentences per profile are not repeated throughput measurements.
ASR roundtrip is diagnostic and cannot prove pronunciation, gender or meaning completeness.
audio_acceptance: User listened to all six samples and replied: Both match and all words are audible. This accepts the bounded sample voices/word audibility, not all future utterances or long-video quality.
pitch_diagnostic_version_note: The embedded pitch_diagnostic preserves the earlier helper thresholds (voicedFraction>=0.6, voicedSeconds>=1.5). Current helper CPU-only recomputation with source hash and thresholds is current-pitch-diagnostics.json. Raw results and human-listening acceptance are unchanged.
